correctness.rationale: For each generator image, Frobenius sends distinct monomials to distinct surviving monomials, giving exactly c_i independent p^{e_i}-power-zero coefficient equations. The automorphism locus is the open set with invertible equal-height diagonal blocks. The tangent dimension is rN because all relation differentials vanish, while the scheme dimension is rN-sum_i c_i. The finite example is only a sanity check.
